auth.description: Enter your Hume AI API key from the Hume Portal (https://platform.hume.ai/settings/keys)

generate_text_to_speech.name: generate_text_to_speech
generate_text_to_speech.description: Convert text to speech using Hume AI's expressive text-to-speech technology

text.description: The text to convert to speech

voiceDescription.description: Natural language description of how the speech should sound (tone, accent, style, etc.). If no voice is specified, this will generate a dynamic voice.

speed.description: Speed multiplier for the synthesized speech (0.75-1.5 recommended)

numGenerations.description: Number of audio generations to produce (1-5 recommended)

contextText.description: Optional context text to influence speech style and prosody consistency

contextDescription.description: Description for the context text (how it should sound)

trailingSilence.description: Duration of silence to add at the end of the speech

splitUtterances.description: Automatically split text into natural-sounding speech segments

aiMetadata.description: Synthesize expressive speech audio from text via Hume AI and return it as an audio file (mp3/wav/pcm). Optionally steer the voice with a natural-language description (omit to generate a dynamic voice) and request multiple generations in one call. Use to produce spoken audio from a text string. Each call generates fresh audio, so it is not idempotent.

generate_speech_from_file.name: generate_speech_from_file
generate_speech_from_file.description: Convert audio file to speech using Hume AI's expressive text-to-speech technology

text.description: The text to convert to speech

voiceDescription.description: Natural language description of how the speech should sound (tone, accent, style, etc.). If no voice is specified, this will generate a dynamic voice.

speed.description: Speed multiplier for the synthesized speech (0.75-1.5 recommended)

contextText.description: Optional context text to influence speech style and prosody consistency

contextDescription.description: Description for the context text (how it should sound)

trailingSilence.description: Duration of silence to add at the end of the speech

splitUtterances.description: Automatically split text into natural-sounding speech segments

aiMetadata.description: Synthesize expressive speech from text via Hume AI and return a single downloadable audio file (mp3/wav/pcm). Like Generate Text to Speech but returns the raw audio file directly rather than JSON metadata; choose this when you just need the audio file output. Optionally steer the voice with a natural-language description. Each call generates fresh audio, so it is not idempotent.

create_voice.name: create_voice
create_voice.description: Save a custom voice to your account using a TTS generation ID

generationId.description: The unique ID from a previous TTS generation to save as a custom voice

voiceName.description: A descriptive name for your custom voice

aiMetadata.description: Save a reusable custom voice in your Hume AI account from a prior TTS generation ID, under a chosen name. Use after generating speech you want to persist and reuse in later synthesis calls. Requires a valid generation ID from an earlier Generate Text to Speech result; creates a new voice resource on each call (not idempotent).

delete_voice.name: delete_voice
delete_voice.description: Delete a custom voice from your account

voiceName.description: The name of the custom voice to delete

aiMetadata.description: Permanently remove a saved custom voice from your Hume AI account, identified by its voice name. Use to clean up voices that are no longer needed. Deletion is keyed on the name and converges to the same end state, so re-running with the same name is idempotent.

analyze_emotions_from_url.name: analyze_emotions_from_url
analyze_emotions_from_url.description: Start a batch emotion analysis job for media files hosted at URLs

urls.description: URLs to media files to analyze (images, videos, audio). Supports up to 100 URLs or archives (.zip, .tar.gz)

models.description: Specify which models to use for inference. Leave empty to run all models.

transcription.description: Include speech-to-text transcription in the analysis

callbackUrl.description: Optional webhook URL to receive results when the job completes

notify.description: Send email notification upon job completion or failure

aiMetadata.description: Start an asynchronous Hume AI Expression Measurement batch job over media (image, video, audio) referenced by URL, returning a job ID; results are fetched later with Get Emotion Results. Use to measure emotional expression in hosted media. Accepts up to 100 URLs or archives, with optional model selection, transcription, callback URL, and email notification. Each call queues a new job, so it is not idempotent.

get_emotion_results.name: get_emotion_results
get_emotion_results.description: Retrieve emotion analysis predictions from a completed batch job

jobId.description: The ID of the emotion analysis job to retrieve results for

aiMetadata.description: Fetch the predictions and current state of a Hume AI Expression Measurement batch job by its job ID. Use after starting a job with Analyze Emotions from URL to poll for and collect results; the job may still be processing if not yet complete. This is a read-only lookup and is idempotent.

new_voice.name: new_voice
new_voice.description: Triggers when a new voice is created in Hume AI

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new custom voice appears in the connected Hume AI account, polling the custom voice list on an interval. Each emitted event represents one newly detected custom voice.
